character_system_text.text: Cygames
Umamusume: Pretty Derby!

Thank you very much. For
noticing me. And for providing
the things I lacked…

I… I want to live up to how you
see me. To your expectations……
I really do…

Because you told me that you
chose me… I… I want to believe
in myself too.

T-This year… I'll become
someone people look up to…!
For sure… No, definitely!

Trainer…! Today is Va-
Vale… Valen…… N-No,
sorry, it's nothing…

C-Ch-Choco!! Be-Because it's
Valentine's…! It's my thanks……
for… everything.
Where should I hang my tanzaku… Somewhere hidden away, out of sight…
T-Trick or Treat. Give candy or— Eek!? No, I didn't mean…! I-I… I was just practicing!

Our family's Christmas party is
always way too flamboyant.
But every time I try to slip away,
Vivlos finds out…

Th-The lights along the seaside
are so pretty… I wish I could
have seen them up close…

What souvenirs should I get…?
Something striking that everyone
likes, maybe… This is so hard……

Ha-Happy birthday… to you…♪
…C-Congratulations.

I also got you… a present.
I-It's a pretty conch keychain!
It reminded me of your dazzling
eyes…
My parents sent me a gift… I wonder if it's something tasty like last year… hehe.

A-A birthday present? For me?
You didn't have to… Just hearing
your blessings already made me
so happy…

A message came by. I-If you're
busy, I can look at it for you…
If you're fine with it, that is…

Ah, I've gathered the gifts for
you on the desk… All you have
to do is retrieve them.
Hah… mission cleared. …Amazing, there's much more to learn from you.

An event, huh… I think…
I'll just observe from afar…
An event huh… Looks fun. But joining with a bunch of people… Uugh…

This badge… I tried sewing it on
after our housemaid taught me…
but it looks a little clumsy,
doesn't it…?

There's crumbs all over my
hoodie again! Ugh, really…
It's definitely Vivlos' doing.

When I walk along the shore,
I often start humming…
Since the sound of the waves
will drown out my voice.

…I must keep moving! Or else
I'll be the only one left behind…

It's fine, I can still go on.
…I have to.

Shall we try something new?
I-I feel like I can do it right now…!

I won't lose to anyone.
At the very least, not in heart…!

If I can maintain this feeling…
I may be able to get closer to
my sisters…
Mm! I feel better than usual. It's really different when you learn under a Trainer…
Umm… What are we going to do today, Trainer? I'm… prepared.

I'll do what I can do, one step
at a time…
Haah… Ah! Sorry… I shouldn't be sighing so much.
Uu… I have a feeling it won't go as well as usual…

No matter what I do… I get
no results. …Maybe I really
am no good.

I'm truly sorry… Even after you
coached me, I couldn't deliver…

I need to… gain a lot of race
experience, right? No more
breaks— N-No, it's nothing…!

Why…? No… No! I don't want
to think like this. I want to win,
I want to be first…!

Alright. I feel in great condition.
So… I'll throw everything I have
at it… and win!

Maybe, right now, I could ——
Alright! Trainer, I-I'll be going…!

In this condition… I think I can
display my very best. I-I'll go
and show you…!

I've done all sorts of prep.
Now, all that's left… is to
trust in its results, right?

Hey, let's go over it one more
time… If I'm going to do this,
I want to try all I can until the
very last moment…!

I must have grown at least
a little… That's why, I'm sure…!

Stay calm, stay calm…
Remember our training…
My condition…? Umm… I think it's not bad.

I'm sure I've done all that
I can… Now if only I can
produce the result…

Everyone here looks strong…
I-I'll think of it as as privilege…

I'm not feeling well today…
B-But you can never know
the outcome until it's over…!

My condition… well, it's not
great. But even so, I'll do my
absolute… best…!

At the very least, with what
I can do now… I hope to
make it till the end…

I'm still far from my best…
But, I'll at least leave my mark…!

………Huh? Sorry, I was lost
in thought…
Let's do this…!
Just a bit more…!
Huaaah…!
Well…
Huh?
Hmm…
Yes…!
Whoa…!

Had I been alone, I probably
wouldn't have made it this far…

Th-Th-Thank you for
your guidance…
Damn it… Next time for sure…!
It's… It's not over yet…!
Ugh, I need to try even harder…

I'm so far… away from
everyone else…

C-Calm down, just do it
like I practiced ——

Hyping up the crowd…
Can I even do that…?
Let's go…!
I'm heading out.
I'm back.

I'm still not confident…
B-But I trust you, who
believes in me.
Good morning. U-Um, well, uh… What a nice morning this is!?

Can I hear about our training
plan now? I'd like to get a rough
idea in my head.

If I wrote everything from class
down, I'll run out of notebooks
fast… How do others manage…?
Um! I'd like to review my form at lunch… Can you watch the videos with me?

I had another strange dream.
My jaw felt tired when I woke
up… Haven't I had enough
dreams about food…?
Uu… I mustn't drink too much at night. I don't want to have to get up and confront that thing…

The newest students seem
really fast… I must work even
harder to keep up.
Aren't you a bit hot in the sun…? Umm… maybe you should wear a hat? It'll be better, I think…

Scad, mackerel, squid…
Which one should I try fishing
for? …Maybe all of them!

During winter, when my dad has
free time, we often go ice fishing.
I always look forward to it…
I need to return Kitasan's handkerchief… But she's always surrounded by people… Going through that crowd… Uugh…!

Calling me "Fishing Master"…
Dia seems to think a bit too
highly of me…
Crown's reviews are so well written… Haah… I'd really like to try those Hong Kong steamed buns too…
I want to play catch… but the idea of having to talk… haah. I'll just play with the wall again…
This morning's sports paper had another huge article about my sister… Haah, how can the gap be this big…?
I do want to be number one, but… haah. Standing in the center of the stage… Am I really cut out for that…?

D-Do I look strange? Like these
clothes don't fit well, or this style
just isn't for me…

This cape looks beautiful no
matter how many times I see it…
It's like glowing, shimmering
plankton.

I don't mind standing out when
I'm wearing this, for once. In a
positive way… it feels like I'm
someone different.

Duramente was first to morning
practice again. …I should wake
up earlier as well.

Earth was playing even over
lunch break. She really loves
music, doesn't she. …She had
such a lovely timbre, too.

Homework is done, textbooks are
ready for tomorrow. Now I just
have to sleep… Hmm, maybe I'll
double-check everything.
I-I caught a really big black seabream recently…! Ah… um… T-That's all I wanted to say…

The swimsuit Vivlos gave me…
What do I do…!? I can't wear
such a vibrant, frilly thing…!

It's spring in Australia, isn't it…
If I send a picture of the autumn
leaves to my childhood friend
over there, they'd be so
surprised…
Meat buns in winter… taste especially delicious. Steaming hot in the cold weather… Hwaa～

Are my sisters training too?
…Hmm, no, it doesn't matter.
Focus!

Can we increase the training
intensity a bit more…? I'm still
not seeing results…
Um… If there's anything you notice, could you please point it out…?

…I need to burn off
the snacks I ate.
The sand… feels so nice… Uh, focus, focus…!

H-How do I look now?
Have I grown a little…?

Having you here, Trainer,
makes me feel at ease… I can
move forward without worry.
Um… thank you. Thank you for choosing me. For becoming… my trainer.

Thank you… my grand
and wonderful Trainer.

My strong points… You've taught
me so much about them.

Accumulating experience
is important, right?
I never knew I had it in me…!
I'm Cheval Grand. Um… pleased to meet you.

I can't stay in my shell anymore…
I am a great Umamusume too…!
U-Uhm… L-Let's do our best～!
Because, I have a dream…
Fair and square…!
Alright, confidence…!
I'll pass…
I-It's okay…!
I won't be a burden…!
Was I able to contribute…?
No! Just one more…
S-Sorry…
They were all… amazing.

That's a magnificent
result… right?
Guh, almost there…
P-Please forgive me…!
I will earn everyone's gaze…!

Even someone like me… Even I…
No matter what, I want to be
"grand"…!!

It wasn't anyone else…
It was me! Trainer, I won…!

I can have a little confidence
today, right…?!
A-Alright, I'm off.
Hey… Here's today's bonus.
It seems this is tomorrow's.

Trainer, what's the training
schedule for today…?

You can learn a lot from history,
right? There might be hints on
how to get stronger…
If you're registering for a race, I would like to… Ah, i-i-if you don't mind…
Ah… the Archive level seems to have gone up.
M-Me…!?
Someday, I will become a grand Umamusume…!

I must become someone
who can be of use…

I-If there's anything
I can help with…!

With this power, I'll become
stronger…!
D-Do your best…!
Whoa…!
Ah…
Amazing… What a great catch…!
A-As expected…!
That's… such a shame.
Amazing… What a great catch…!
A-As expected…!
Hehe.
W-Weeell…
Hmm…
Look…!
Woah…!
Mmm……
Um…?
Just like this…!
A big one…!
N-Not even close…!
Wawawah…!

To think I'm a member of this
academy too… It's still hard
to believe.

I think my ironing skills…
have improved a little?

I-It's embarrassing when you
keep staring at me like that…

I have to get used to singing
as the main star on stage…!

I want to become stronger…
to be more worthy of my
racewear.
Hooo… Act confident. Confident…!

To think I'm a part of this
Academy too… I still find
it hard to believe.

My ironing skills…
have improved, right?

I-It's embarrassing when you
stare at me so much…

I have to get used to singing
as the main star on stage…!

I want to become stronger…
to be more worthy of this
racewear.
Hooo… Act confident. Confident…!
I won't hold everyone back…!
Umm… let's do our best～!
T-Thank you for your guidance…

I must have gotten a little
stronger… Which means,
Trainer…!

In this condition… I think I can
give this race all I have right now.
I-I'll go and show you…!
Th-Thank you for your guidance…
M-Morning…!! N-No, um… I thought I should try a lively greeting for once… or something …… uugh…
Uu… my eyes… The rising sun is just too bright for me without a hat…
I thought about using the fish I caught for a side dish… but… Uu, someone like me can't fully bring out the flavors…

I-I'm going to raise my hand
in this afternoon's class…!
Even I… should be able to
do that…!

When I can't sleep? I count
fishes… Like, "caught one fish,
caught two fish…".
Yeah, even when you go to bed early, you wake up and get hungry. ……Eh, is it just me…?
To the juniors, I am a senior… so I should be more… dependable… like, strand straight…! Gah, m-my back… It hurts…

Volleyball, banana boats,
watermelon splitting… I'm a little
tired, but this kind of summer…
is nice once in a while?

Autumn melancholy… I can relate
somewhat. When the baseball
season ends in autumn…
it makes me feel a little sad.
Um, is there any snow on my head? …I see. Phoo. Hats are truly great inventions…

I share quite a few interests with
Shion… Like being a dog person,
or liking sports manga…

I don't want to be the one who's
always helped… I want to help
Crown too… Maybe with fishing
or baseball…

Vivlos, I swear… First swimsuits,
now dresses and "celebrity
sisters"…? I'm at my limit. No.
Absolutely, NO!

Duramente… It's not that she
was bad at fishing… She just
struggled to restrain her power.
It was… kind of cute…
Ai always looks me straight in the eyes when she talks… Uugh, she's just too much for me…!

This sweatshirt is the only
thing I chose myself. So, you
c-complimenting it… made me
really happy…!

The nail polish on my toes
chipped… Should I ask Vivlos
or Crown again…? N-No, this
time I'll try doing it myself!

The scent of the sea?
Ah… it's because this morning,
I went to the beach to train.
The sea breeze… felt really nice.
The cafeteria's special menu tomorrow is… Sichuan, hmmh. It will be a scramble… b-but, I'll try my best…?
I fell asleep last night with my stomach exposed… Uugh… I ended up showing Shion such an embarrassing side of me…
Flower viewing… There will definitely be tons of people… but Kitasan went out of her way to invite me… Uugh… what should I do…

Sparklers really are… best on
the beach. The smell of the sea
and gunpowder, the tiny light
illuminating the sand… It's nice…
I ate too much… of the autumn delicacies. Uugh… I'll go to the batting cages to work off my fat…
My parents sent me a belly warmer so I don't catch a cold. It's just, um… the cutesy puppy pattern is a bit…

I might not be like the sun, but
I'll burn with fighting spirit too…
L-Let's go!

I brought lots of sports drinks
to prevent dehydration and salt
loss. …D-Did I bring too many?

Be bolder, like this swimsuit…
I wonder what… bold training
would look like…?

Duramente taught me
a warm-up routine. Can I…
try it out for a bit…?

You're so open-minded and
warm… Just like the summer sea.
Maybe that's why I can say what
I'm thinking…
Maybe it's true… wearing a swimsuit really does make you more open… I want to try my best at various things with you, Trainer…
Even if my efforts amounts to nothing… compared to my old self who couldn't muster any courage, I'm prouder of who I am now.

Next season… and further into
the future… I want to keep moving
forward with you, Trainer…

Riding the waves together…
is how we made it here.
I-I'm going to transform…!

The power of a swimsuit…
seems really formidable…

Cheval… Grand…
It's not… strange, is it…?
Since it's summer… um, I'll join in…

I like the design. Whether it
suits me… is another matter.
As it's summer… um, I guess I should also…

I like the design. Whether it
suits me… is an entirely
different matter.

B-Be a little… bolder…
No no no, I just can't do it…!
I have to steel my resolve…!
Haa… Okay, I need to channel my coura— eeh!? W-W-W-Wha… D-Don't look at meee! …uuugh…
Ehehe… Victory… you know～

It's okay to have a little
confidence today, right?

I just hope it doesn't
look strange on me…

Wearing something like this…
is okay once in a while…
I'm glad it doesn't look strange…

Wearing something like this
once in a while… is alright.
Ha… Happy… Valentine's…
Ha-Happy Valentine's Day…
Thanks for your time.
Let's get serious.

The concert with Nature was
amazing. They all have their
own reasons for being loved,
huh… but I ——

Even someone like me has fans…
I'm still not confident… but I want to… r-respond to that support.
The "Crispy Fried Chicken with Plum Sauce" at the restaurant here is so good… Would it be rude to order a second serving…?

There's even an option for
offshore fishing… I'd love to try
that in my free time… Huh?
W-We can catch tuna!?
If… I bought a bold swimsuit like that… N-No, I can't! It won't suit me! Maybe when I have more confidence… No, impossible!

Is it okay… if I go for a short
walk along the shore?

…Yeah. It's easy to move in
and relaxing…
